description: Search the Fortitude21 liquid containment catalogue: steel, stainless, aluminium, tinplate and UN-rated HDPE jerry cans, pails, tins, drums, spill pallets, closures and handling equipment. Filter by material, capacity in litres, category, application, certification and pricing type. Terms are combined with AND and a product with no recorded value for a filtered attribute is excluded rather than assumed to match, so an empty result means no product satisfies every condition. Returns a summary per product with the url for the full record.

certification.description: UN, or a design code such as 3H1 or 3A1

limit.description: Results per page, up to 100. Default 20

material.description: hdpe, polypropylene, polyethylene, stainless, steel, galvanised, aluminium, tinplate, plastic or metal. Resolved to the material family, so hdpe does not return polypropylene

q.description: Free text, e.g. "20 litre steel fuel can" or "spill pallet for 4 drums"

name: search_products
title: Search Fortitude21 products
